name: world
description: Living world: day/night cycle with 4-preset atmosphere lerp, clear/rain/snow weather machine, ambient audio zones

configKeys.rain_sound: optional sound asset id/url for rain ambience
configKeys.snow_sound: optional sound asset id/url for snow ambience

configKeys.zones: [{pos={x,y,z}, radius, sound_id, volume?}] — looped ambient audio emitters
